subject: Gemini 4 Neon 🧠, OpenAI Chip Model +14% PPA 🔧, Devin Bots 🤖
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. Sponsor blocks (Collibra, Orkes, Wispr Flow) and event promos ignored.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens
stories.quote: Google DeepMind ships Gemini 4 Neon, ranking #3 on the Intelligence Index
stories.description: Gemini 4 Neon model, between cheaper Hydrogen and more powerful Carbon

facts.text: Input price: $3 per million input tokens
Output price: $15 per million output tokens
Positioned between Hydrogen (cheaper) and Carbon (more powerful); described as faster and cheaper per task than Carbon
facts.quote: , a new model sitting between the cheaper Hydrogen and the more powerful Carbon. Think of it as the sweet spot: near-Carbon reasoning quality, but faster and cheaper per task.

facts.text: 1M token context window shared across input, thinking and output
Four thinking levels: low, medium, high, xhigh
facts.quote: Four thinking levels: low, medium, high, and xhigh, so you control how hard it thinks and what you spend

facts.text: Available via the Gemini API, AI Studio and Android Studio
facts.quote: You can use it right now via the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Android Studio with model ID

stories.headline: OpenAI's chip design models found up to 14% PPA improvement on AMD's flagship GPU
stories.quote: OpenAI's chip design model delivers 14% hardware gains on AMD's GPU
stories.description: AI models that rewrite chip circuit code

facts.text: Up to 14% PPA (power, performance, area) improvement on AMD's flagship GPU, in less than five months
facts.quote: on AMD's flagship GPU. PPA stands for power, performance, and area: how efficient, fast, and compact a chip is. That's roughly a year of progress achieved in less than five months.

facts.text: AMD has included some changes in a recent design sent for manufacturing
facts.quote: AMD has already included some changes in a recent design sent for manufacturing, with others added to production files for future versions.

facts.text: Same approach run on Jalapeño, OpenAI's own custom chip, with gains confirmed on real silicon
facts.quote: , its own custom chip built to run AI models, with gains confirmed on real silicon.

facts.text: GPT-Synopsys: a new model trained to use Synopsys EDA tools
facts.quote: : a new model trained to use Synopsys EDA tools the way expert chip designers do.

stories.headline: Cognition launches Devin Bots, an AI manager that coordinates multiple Devin agents
stories.quote: Cognition launches Devin Bots, helping engineers merge 4.5x more PRs
stories.description: AI manager that splits goals into tasks for parallel Devin agents

facts.text: Beta testers merge 4.5x more pull requests per message
One team went from 50 to nearly 2,000 PRs a week
The Bot breaks a goal into tasks, runs multiple Devin agents in parallel and checks their output
facts.quote: The Bot takes a big goal, breaks it into tasks, spins up multiple Devin agents to work in parallel, checks their output, and only pings you when a real decision is needed.
